name: Luna Filicinna
original_name: ルーナ・フィリシンナ
source:
Race: Anima

An officer in the Frost Special Neutral Zone. She has been [url=/c132078]Kai[/url]'s drinking buddy since he came to this area. Occasionally, she secretly gives him information about the Special Neutral Zone. Genuine and straightforward, she is loyal to her country, the Jimill Republic.
